prompt: Create only a strict TOP view of this solid cast-concrete Jersey road barrier. Use SOURCE, RIGHT, LEFT, and BOTTOM as the geometry authorities; disregard the current rejected TOP in the earlier contact. It is a single heavy poured concrete obstacle, not a gate/boom. Straight down at 90 degrees, no perspective or horizon. Draw the complete broad footprint matching BOTTOM: overall full-span width about 220 units and depth about 95 units (roughly 2.3:1). The center has a narrow longitudinal concrete ridge; on both long sides the sloped Jersey flanks are visible as broad concrete top-facing planes within the footprint, reaching the wide base edges. Keep trapezoidal/tapered ends and source lifting-handle loops at their ends. The red/white stripes belong to the concrete flanks and may appear on those visible upward-facing planes, but the camera must remain exactly overhead. Preserve solid concrete continuity and source identity. Absolutely no metal base plates, no separate posts, no hinges/rotors/lights, no thin arm. Complete isolated object, transparent 256x256 canvas, centered. Inferred principal view, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.

maintain source stripe paint and handle loops
